prompts.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: landscape illustration for a synthetic content-quality diagnostic card
Primary request: Illustrate title identity verification as a real editorial task. Show a content curator at a worktable comparing one partially obscured fictional film frame with a canonical catalog binder and a matching clean poster thumbnail. The curator uses a magnifying glass and connecting evidence markers to determine whether the frame belongs to the expected fictional title. Make the verification action immediately readable without relying on words.
Style/medium: match the supplied article-cover reference only in medium and visual language: warm #FCFAF4 paper, loose expressive navy ink, fine hand-drawn hatching, restrained translucent teal, amber, and muted rust watercolor, subtle paper texture, polished editorial warmth. Do not copy its robot, black cube, composition, or symbols.
Composition/framing: horizontal 8:5 composition; clear foreground evidence, curator in the middle ground, organized catalog context behind; strong focal relationship at card size.
Constraints: entirely fictional; no text, letters, numbers, logos, real titles, recognizable actors, brands, studios, networks, employers, watermarks, UI screenshots, or existing entertainment properties.
Avoid: abstract geometric templates, flat vector diagrams, photorealism, gradients, generic office stock scenes, and decorative shapes unrelated to the work.
